name: sosciencity
title: Sosciencity
author: tirisabella, Johanna Spieker, _traum
description:
Factorio: Skylines. Adds citizens to the game. Attract various castes to your city in order to progress the game.

Sosciencity's buildings are scaled so their doors are about one tile tall - the vanilla engineer is a freaking giant next to them. If that bothers you, I recommend miniMAXIme, which shrinks him to a size that fits the city.
